title: Lena and the Autopsy
author: Paloma Fairweather
blurb: Freya Villalobos, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
